features.name: Image resize service
features.summary: On-the-fly resize / crop / filter by URL, cached. fit-in / fill / stretch, focus incl. smart, sharpen / blur / grayscale / webp / avif, signed URLs.

test.how: Open the test view, drop in your own logo/image and try fit / size / focus / filters, or attach an image in chat for true sharp-service renders.

features.name: Frame-accurate scrub & clip
features.summary: Pull any frame on demand from the chunked origin, scrub via sprite + I-frame trick-play, cut a frame-accurate clip. No proxies.

test.how: Run the prototype (volt-frame-proto.zip): npm install → node test.mjs → node server.mjs → open /scrub. 15/15 assertions.

features.checks: 15/15 assertions (frame-accuracy MAD 0.02, exact clip, sprite, trick-play)

features.name: Secure share page
features.summary: Time-boxed standalone preview link for one asset. Revoke, expiry, max-views, optional PIN, watermarked preview, allow-download, notify-on-open.

test.how: Say the word and I'll spin up a live sample share link + page from the local console so you can click expiry / PIN / revoke. Backend is 20/20 e2e.

features.checks: 20/20 e2e (isolation, PIN, revoke→410, expiry→410, download gating)

features.name: Live captions + translation
features.summary: Optional per account. Self-hosted whisper + NLLB (en↔ms/zh/ta and more) or Gladia. Whisper runs as a separate GPU add-on only when needed.

test.how: Attach a short audio/video clip in chat and I'll caption + translate it and return the WebVTT tracks, or run the encoder unit tests.

features.checks: 33 + 9 + 6 tests; proven end-to-end espeak → whisper → NLLB

features.name: Local test console (login + all tabs)
features.summary: Browser console over the live API: overview, channels (start/stop), events, EPG, VOD, analytics, tickets, notifications + SaaS admin tab.

test.how: In volt-app: ./run-local.sh, open /console, sign in (admin@rtm.example / saas@volt.example, pw volt1234). Flip between logins to see tenant isolation.

features.name: Record edit API + audit trail
features.summary: Edit channels/events/schemas with PATCH (send only changed fields; null clears), optimistic concurrency (If-Match/version, 409 on stale write), and a full audit trail: who created/changed each record, field-level diffs, and per-record history.

test.how: PATCH /api/channels/:id (or events / metadata-schemas), then GET /api/channels/:id/history. Try a stale If-Match to see the 409. Postman collection covers it; or attach me a scenario and I'll run it.

features.checks: 23 e2e (partial patch, version bump, 409 conflict, null-clear, create/update/delete audit, history) + verify.sh 38/38

features.name: Live updates (admin)
features.summary: When one admin changes a field, others viewing the same record see it update live, over the existing SSE hub. Public front-end live kept minimal (EPG served from CDN + client boundary advance) so 500k viewers add no per-viewer load.

test.how: Designed, builds on the edit+audit foundation just shipped. Not testable yet.

features.checks: design agreed; admin SSE + Postgres NOTIFY

features.name: EPG & scheduling
features.summary: Programme store, RRULE recurrence, materialised instances, now/next, conflict detection.

test.how: Exercisable via the console EPG tab and /api/epg. 7 pure + 6 HTTP tests.

features.name: Analytics & reporting
features.summary: Server-side audience / QoS / realtime from CDN logs; by-app + device; realtime concurrency.

test.how: View in the console Analytics tab (seeded data) or hit /api/analytics/*.

features.name: SaaS admin dashboard
features.summary: Cross-tenant overview: active servers, projected instances, channels, viewers, tickets; MFA 2-step login; impersonation (deferred).

test.how: Sign in to the console as saas@volt.example to see the SaaS Admin tab across tenants.

features.name: Publish a clip to social media
features.summary: Push a clip to YouTube / Facebook / X / TikTok / Dailymotion. Data model + APIs exist; real upload adapters pending.

test.how: Not testable yet — needs each platform's OAuth app credentials from you before the upload adapters go live.

features.name: File manager
features.summary: Upload / organise watermarks, slates, logos, source media. S3-backed with direct-to-S3 upload.

test.how: Designed only — see DESIGN_file_manager_watchfolder.md. Build starts on your go-ahead.

features.name: Watchfolder ingest
features.summary: Assign a folder or S3 bucket/prefix as an auto ingest source; new files become assets / VOD / slates / playlist items.

test.how: Designed only — see DESIGN_file_manager_watchfolder.md. Build starts on your go-ahead.

features.name: Test stream, playback & live subtitles
features.summary: One-click test stream per channel: FFmpeg generates a real live HLS/DASH ladder from a test card, the app plays it back for real (hls.js) with working DVR scrub-back, and a live WebVTT caption track renders over the video with EN/MS/ZH/TA switching (sample now; real Whisper mode available).

test.how: Run the app on your Mac (bash run-on-mac.sh, needs ffmpeg), open a channel, click 'Start test stream'. The output player plays the live HLS; toggle CC and switch languages; drag the DVR bar back and hit Go live.

features.checks: generator + captions + /origin serving + start/stop API validated; player is hls.js (H.264 plays in Chrome/Safari on Mac)

features.name: Channels — list & create (transcode/package)
features.summary: Channels list (empty state, filter chips, start/stop) + a create drawer that branches by type: transcode = one source + optional backup + selectable output ladder + filler-on-loss; package = per-rendition input rows + fallback (matching URLs or a single source transcoded to all bitrates).
features.checks: create inserts channel + stream_inputs + ladder + filler (both flows) verified via API

test.how: Channels → New channel. Pick Transcode or Packaging; fill the type-specific fields; Create. It appears in the list.

features.name: Channel detail / control page
features.summary: Per-channel control page: dual source/output players, EPG now/next, realtime viewers chart, output+source status board with rendition ladder, event log, and an editable settings drawer (source, geo rules, DVR window ≤4h/mode, subtitles, retention). Source-gated go-live.
features.checks: detail endpoint + optimistic-concurrency PATCH + audit diff verified

test.how: Click a channel in the list. Send source → Go live; toggle CC; drag the DVR bar; open Settings and save a change.

features.name: Deep-linking & routing (hashless)
features.summary: Clean History-API URLs: /channels, /channels/:id, /channels/new, /:section. Bookmarkable, reloadable, back/forward work; sidebar items are real links.
features.checks: type-checked; Vite SPA fallback (live browser check blocked by sandbox)

test.how: Open /channels/<id> directly, reload a channel page, use browser back/forward.

features.name: Bitrate ladder profiles (library + CRUD)
features.summary: Managed library of output ladder profiles (reuses output_profiles): list, create from scratch or copy an existing profile, rename, edit; delete with an API-level confirmation workflow + in-use guard + audit log. Assign a profile to a transcode channel's output.
features.checks: in progress — schema + seed + CRUD + UI + assign

test.how: Profiles → New (or copy an existing) → edit rungs → save. Assign it when creating a transcode channel. Try deleting one in use (blocked) and an unused one (confirm required).
